name: com.amap/mcp
title: Amap Maps
description: Geocoding, places, routes and weather from Amap (高德地图).

com.linjiejim.greenhouse/connector.description_zh: 高德地图的地理编码、地点搜索、路线规划与天气查询。

auth.help: An Amap Web Service key (create an app in the Amap console, then add a key of type "Web 服务").
auth.help_zh: 高德开放平台的「Web 服务」Key：在控制台创建应用并添加 Key 即可。

verification.notes: The key travels as the `key` query parameter (Greenhouse stores it encrypted and adds it at call time). Without a valid key the server answers INVALID_USER_KEY outside JSON-RPC. The SSE endpoint was retired on 2026-03-17. Not listed in the MCP Registry; the version is the catalog entry's own (the server reports none without a key).
